ORGANIZATIONS.TITLE: Organizations
ORGANIZATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Prospects and customers, companies or general public, with their contacts.
ORGANIZATIONS.SEARCH: Search by name, tax ID or domain
ORGANIZATIONS.EMPTY: There are no organizations here yet.
ORGANIZATIONS.ERROR: The organization could not be saved
ORGANIZATIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this organization? Its contacts stay, just without an organization.

FORM.NAME: Name or legal name
FORM.TAX_ID_HINT: Optional: it can be filled in when invoicing.

CONTACT.TITLE: Organization
CONTACT.NONE: No organization: it is a contact.

PICKER.LABEL: Organization (optional)
PICKER.PLACEHOLDER: Search organization by name or tax ID

RULES.TITLE: Automatic prospects and customers
RULES.DESCRIPTION: What turns an organization into a prospect or a customer without doing it by hand. It can always be changed by hand from the organization.

GROUPS.prospect: Becomes a prospect (if the contact has no organization, one is created)

ITEMS.prospect_on_opportunity: When an opportunity is created (includes «Converted» in the contact funnel)

ORGANIZATIONS.IMPORT_HELP: Columns: id, nombre, tipo (empresa or publico_en_general), etapa (prospecto or cliente), rfc, giro, sitio_web, dominio_correo, telefono, direccion, responsable (email), notas, contactos (emails or phones separated by «;»). Matched by id, tax ID or name: if it exists it is updated.

ASSISTANT.TITLE: Organizations for your contacts
ASSISTANT.DESCRIPTION: Proposal for the contacts that have no organization yet. Review, remove or fix what you don't want and then apply.
ASSISTANT.EMPTY: Nothing to propose: all your contacts with a company, domain or activity already have an organization.

SOURCES.company: By the company written on the contact
SOURCES.person: Customer without a company (has a contract or a won opportunity)

ASSISTANT.EXISTING: already exists: they will be linked to it
ASSISTANT.DONE: Done: {created} new organizations and {linked} contacts linked

DASHBOARD.TITLE: Customers dashboard
DASHBOARD.DESCRIPTION: Prospects and customers: how many there are, how many arrived and how long they take to buy.
